3a8b95623bfbca0404372fe5d4a9fa89dbfa3aa8.summary: Dark Matter (report by Taha K.) describes WINDSHIFT APT, a long-term, non-attributable cyber-espionage actor that targets specific individuals and government bodies, mainly in the Middle East. Its methods include fake personas, credential-harvesting phishing and macOS and Windows backdoors (WINDTAIL, WINDTAPE, WINDDROP). The report says it reuses tools linked to Appin Security and shows overlaps with BAHAMUT, Fancy Bear and SOFACY infrastructure. The India link is presented as an overlap, not a confirmed attribution.
